description.en: Primary somatosensory cortex on the crown of the postcentral gyrus.
description.uz: Postcentral burma cho'qqisidagi birlamchi somatosensor po'stloq.

role.en: Texture and fine touch discrimination.
role.uz: Tekstura va nozik sezgini farqlash.

clinical.en: Contralateral loss of discriminative touch.
clinical.uz: Qarama-qarshi tomonda farqlovchi sezgining yo'qolishi.

description.en: Primary somatosensory cortex on the posterior wall of the postcentral gyrus, bordering the postcentral sulcus.
description.uz: Postcentral burma orqa devoridagi, postcentral egat bilan chegaradosh birlamchi somatosensor po'stloq.

role.en: Joint position sense and the size and shape of objects in the hand (stereognosis).
role.uz: Bo'g'im holati sezgisi va qo'ldagi narsaning o'lchami va shakli (stereognoz).

clinical.en: Astereognosis.
clinical.uz: Astereognoz.

description.en: Primary somatosensory cortex in the posterior wall (3b) and floor (3a) of the central sulcus — the main entry of touch to the cortex.
description.uz: Markaziy egat orqa devori (3b) va tubidagi (3a) birlamchi somatosensor po'stloq — sezgining po'stloqqa asosiy kirishi.

role.en: 3b: detailed map of skin touch; 3a: proprioception from muscle spindles.
role.uz: 3b: teri sezgisining batafsil xaritasi; 3a: mushak duklaridan propriotseptsiya.

clinical.en: Cortical sensory loss on the opposite side; focal sensory seizures (tingling marching along a limb).
clinical.uz: Qarama-qarshi tomonda kortikal sensor yetishmovchilik; fokal sensor tutqanoqlar (oyoq-qo'l bo'ylab tarqaluvchi jimirlash).

description.en: Primary motor cortex on the precentral gyrus and anterior wall of the central sulcus, with giant Betz cells in layer V.
description.uz: Precentral burma va markaziy egat oldingi devoridagi birlamchi harakat po'stlog'i; V qatlamda ulkan Betz hujayralari.

role.en: Executes voluntary movement of the opposite body via the corticospinal tract (motor homunculus).
role.uz: Kortikospinal trakt orqali tananing qarama-qarshi tomonining ixtiyoriy harakatini bajaradi (harakat gomunkulusi).

clinical.en: Contralateral hemiparesis; Jacksonian motor seizures.
clinical.uz: Qarama-qarshi gemiparez; Jackson harakat tutqanoqlari.

description.en: Somatosensory association cortex in the superior parietal lobule behind the postcentral gyrus.
description.uz: Postcentral burma orqasidagi yuqori tepa bo'lakchasida somatosensor assotsiativ po'stloq.

role.en: Integrates touch and proprioception into a body schema used for reaching.
role.uz: Sezgi va propriotseptsiyani qo'l uzatishda ishlatiladigan tana sxemasiga birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Tactile agnosia and impaired reaching.
clinical.uz: Taktil agnoziya va qo'l uzatishning buzilishi.

description.en: Premotor cortex on the lateral surface and the supplementary motor area on the medial surface, in front of area 4.
description.uz: 4-maydon oldida: lateral yuzada premotor po'stloq va medial yuzada qo'shimcha harakat maydoni.

role.en: Plans and sequences movements: premotor for externally cued actions, SMA for internally generated and bimanual sequences.
role.uz: Harakatlarni rejalashtiradi va ketma-ketligini belgilaydi: premotor — tashqi signalga bog'liq harakatlar, SMA — ichki hosil qilingan va ikki qo'l ketma-ketliklari uchun.

clinical.en: Apraxia; SMA syndrome (transient akinesia and mutism after surgery).
clinical.uz: Apraksiya; SMA sindromi (jarrohlikdan keyingi o'tkinchi akineziya va mutizm).

description.en: Superior parietal lobule and precuneus — visuomotor association cortex.
description.uz: Yuqori tepa bo'lakchasi va precuneus — vizuomotor assotsiativ po'stloq.

role.en: Locating objects in space and guiding the hand to them; the precuneus contributes to self-awareness and episodic memory retrieval.
role.uz: Narsalarni fazoda topish va qo'lni ularga yo'naltirish; precuneus o'zini anglash va epizodik xotirani chaqirishda qatnashadi.

clinical.en: Optic ataxia; Bálint syndrome when bilateral.
clinical.uz: Optik ataksiya; ikki tomonlama bo'lsa Balint sindromi.

description.en: Frontal cortex in front of area 6 on the superior and middle frontal gyri, containing the frontal eye field.
description.uz: Yuqori va o'rta peshona burmalarida 6-maydon oldidagi peshona po'stlog'i; peshona ko'z maydonini o'z ichiga oladi.

role.en: Voluntary saccadic eye movements to the opposite side and management of uncertainty.
role.uz: Ko'zlarning qarama-qarshi tomonga ixtiyoriy sakkadik harakatlari va noaniqlikni boshqarish.

clinical.en: Lesion: eyes deviate toward the lesion; seizure: eyes deviate away from it.
clinical.uz: Zararlanish: ko'zlar o'choq tomonga og'adi; tutqanoq: ko'zlar o'choqdan teskari og'adi.

description.en: Dorsolateral prefrontal cortex on the superior and middle frontal gyri.
description.uz: Yuqori va o'rta peshona burmalaridagi dorsolateral prefrontal po'stloq.

role.en: Working memory, planning, judgement and inhibition of inappropriate behaviour.
role.uz: Ishchi xotira, rejalashtirish, mulohaza va nomaqbul xulqni tormozlash.

clinical.en: Dysexecutive syndrome; hypoactive in schizophrenia and depression (rTMS target).
clinical.uz: Dizeksekutiv sindrom; shizofreniya va depressiyada gipofaol (rTMS nishoni).

description.en: The frontal pole — the most anterior prefrontal cortex.
description.uz: Peshona qutbi — eng oldingi prefrontal po'stloq.

role.en: Multitasking, prospective memory and reasoning about one's own thoughts.
role.uz: Multitasking, kelajakka mo'ljallangan xotira va o'z fikrlari haqida mulohaza yuritish.

clinical.en: Difficulty with complex planning; damaged in frontal contusions.
clinical.uz: Murakkab rejalashtirishda qiyinchilik; peshona kontuziyalarida zararlanadi.

description.en: Orbitofrontal cortex on the orbital surface of the frontal lobe (areas 11 and 12).
description.uz: Peshona bo'lagi orbital yuzasidagi orbitofrontal po'stloq (11 va 12-maydonlar).

role.en: Reward valuation, smell and taste, social and emotional decision making.
role.uz: Mukofotni baholash, hid va ta'm, ijtimoiy va emotsional qaror qabul qilish.

clinical.en: Disinhibition and impaired judgement (Phineas Gage); OCD circuitry.
clinical.uz: Tormozsizlik va mulohazaning buzilishi (Phineas Gage); OKB zanjiri.

description.en: In this atlas, area 16 labels the insular cortex (Brodmann numbered the insula 13–16 in primates).
description.uz: Bu atlasda 16-maydon insula po'stlog'ini belgilaydi (Brodmann primatlarda insulani 13–16 deb raqamlagan).

role.en: Interoception, taste, pain and emotional awareness.
role.uz: Interotseptsiya, ta'm, og'riq va emotsional anglash.

clinical.en: Insular strokes and seizures — see the insula.
clinical.uz: Insula insultlari va tutqanoqlari — insulaga qarang.

description.en: Primary visual (striate) cortex on the banks of the calcarine sulcus.
description.uz: Kalkarin egat qirg'oqlaridagi birlamchi ko'rish (striat) po'stlog'i.

role.en: Retinotopic map of the opposite visual field; detects edges, orientation and contrast.
role.uz: Qarama-qarshi ko'rish maydonining retinotopik xaritasi; qirralar, yo'nalish va kontrastni aniqlaydi.

clinical.en: Homonymous hemianopia with macular sparing; cortical blindness if bilateral.
clinical.uz: Makula saqlangan gomonim gemianopsiya; ikki tomonlama bo'lsa kortikal ko'rlik.

description.en: Secondary visual cortex (V2) surrounding area 17.
description.uz: 17-maydonni o'rab turuvchi ikkilamchi ko'rish po'stlog'i (V2).

role.en: Contours, depth and colour; feeds the dorsal and ventral streams.
role.uz: Konturlar, chuqurlik va rang; dorsal va ventral oqimlarni oziqlantiradi.

clinical.en: Visual field defects with area 17; visual hallucinations in occipital seizures.
clinical.uz: 17-maydon bilan birga ko'rish maydoni nuqsonlari; ensa tutqanoqlarida ko'rish gallyutsinatsiyalari.

description.en: Visual association cortex (V3–V5) on the lateral and medial occipital lobe.
description.uz: Lateral va medial ensa bo'lagidagi ko'rish assotsiativ po'stlog'i (V3–V5).

role.en: Motion, shape and colour analysis; links vision to memory and language.
role.uz: Harakat, shakl va rang tahlili; ko'rishni xotira va til bilan bog'laydi.

clinical.en: Visual agnosia, akinetopsia, achromatopsia depending on the part affected.
clinical.uz: Zararlangan qismga qarab ko'rish agnoziyasi, akinetopsiya, axromatopsiya.

description.en: Inferior temporal gyrus.
description.uz: Pastki chakka burmasi.

role.en: High-level object and face recognition (ventral stream).
role.uz: Yuqori darajali narsa va yuzlarni tanish (ventral oqim).

clinical.en: Visual agnosia; prosopagnosia.
clinical.uz: Ko'rish agnoziyasi; prozopagnoziya.

description.en: Middle temporal gyrus.
description.uz: O'rta chakka burmasi.

role.en: Semantic memory, word meaning and recognition of familiar faces and objects.
role.uz: Semantik xotira, so'z ma'nosi hamda tanish yuz va narsalarni tanish.

clinical.en: Word-finding difficulty; semantic dementia.
clinical.uz: So'z topishda qiyinchilik; semantik demensiya.

description.en: Superior temporal gyrus; its posterior part in the left hemisphere is Wernicke's area.
description.uz: Yuqori chakka burmasi; chap yarim sharda orqa qismi Vernike maydoni.

role.en: Auditory association cortex: comprehension of spoken language (left), voices and prosody (right).
role.uz: Eshitish assotsiativ po'stlog'i: og'zaki nutqni tushunish (chap), ovozlar va intonatsiya (o'ng).

clinical.en: Wernicke's (fluent) aphasia.
clinical.uz: Vernike (ravon) afaziyasi.

description.en: Posterior cingulate cortex (areas 23 and 31), behind and above the splenium.
description.uz: Splenium orqasi va ustidagi orqa singulyat po'stloq (23 va 31-maydonlar).

role.en: Memory retrieval, spatial orientation and self-referential thought — a core of the default-mode network.
role.uz: Xotirani chaqirish, fazoviy yo'nalish va o'zi haqida fikrlash — default-mode tarmog'i o'zagi.

clinical.en: One of the earliest regions to lose metabolism in Alzheimer disease (FDG-PET).
clinical.uz: Alzheimer kasalligida metabolizmi eng erta pasayadigan sohalardan biri (FDG-PET).

description.en: Anterior cingulate cortex above the corpus callosum.
description.uz: Qadoq tana ustidagi oldingi singulyat po'stloq.

role.en: Error detection, conflict monitoring, motivation, pain affect and autonomic control.
role.uz: Xatolarni aniqlash, ziddiyatni nazorat qilish, motivatsiya, og'riq affekti va vegetativ boshqaruv.

clinical.en: Akinetic mutism when bilateral; cingulotomy target for pain and OCD.
clinical.uz: Ikki tomonlama bo'lsa akinetik mutizm; og'riq va OKBda singulotomiya nishoni.

description.en: Subgenual cingulate cortex under the genu of the corpus callosum.
description.uz: Qadoq tana tizzasi ostidagi subgenual singulyat po'stloq.

role.en: Regulates mood and the autonomic/endocrine response to emotion.
role.uz: Kayfiyat hamda emotsiyaga vegetativ/endokrin javobni boshqaradi.

clinical.en: Overactive in severe depression; DBS target for treatment-resistant depression.
clinical.uz: Og'ir depressiyada giperfaol; davolashga chidamli depressiyada DBS nishoni.

description.en: Ectosplenial (retrosplenial) cortex behind the splenium.
description.uz: Splenium orqasidagi ektosplenial (retrosplenial) po'stloq.

role.en: Spatial memory and navigation with areas 29 and 30.
role.uz: 29 va 30-maydonlar bilan birga fazoviy xotira va yo'nalish.

clinical.en: Topographical disorientation.
clinical.uz: Topografik yo'nalish buzilishi.

description.en: Presubiculum on the medial temporal lobe.
description.uz: Medial chakka bo'lagidagi presubikulum.

role.en: Head-direction cells and spatial memory; part of the hippocampal formation.
role.uz: Bosh yo'nalishi hujayralari va fazoviy xotira; hippokampal formatsiyaning qismi.

clinical.en: Involved in early Alzheimer pathology.
clinical.uz: Erta Alzheimer patologiyasida ishtirok etadi.

description.en: Entorhinal cortex on the anterior parahippocampal gyrus.
description.uz: Oldingi parahippokampal burmadagi entorinal po'stloq.

role.en: Gateway between neocortex and hippocampus; grid cells for navigation.
role.uz: Neokorteks bilan hippokamp orasidagi darvoza; yo'nalish uchun panjara hujayralari.

clinical.en: First site of Alzheimer tangles (Braak I).
clinical.uz: Alzheimer chigallarining birinchi joyi (Braak I).

description.en: Granular retrosplenial cortex.
description.uz: Granulyar retrosplenial po'stloq.

role.en: Links egocentric and map-like representations for navigation; episodic memory.
role.uz: Yo'nalish uchun egotsentrik va xarita-shakl tasavvurlarni bog'laydi; epizodik xotira.

clinical.en: Retrosplenial amnesia and getting lost in familiar places.
clinical.uz: Retrosplenial amneziya va tanish joylarda adashish.

description.en: Agranular retrosplenial cortex.
description.uz: Agranulyar retrosplenial po'stloq.

role.en: Spatial memory and scene processing with area 29.
role.uz: 29-maydon bilan birga fazoviy xotira va manzara qayta ishlovi.

clinical.en: Early hypometabolism in Alzheimer disease.
clinical.uz: Alzheimer kasalligida erta gipometabolizm.

description.en: Dorsal anterior cingulate (32) and pregenual cingulate (33) cortex.
description.uz: Dorsal oldingi singulyat (32) va pregenual singulyat (33) po'stloq.

role.en: Cognitive control, conflict resolution and emotion regulation.
role.uz: Kognitiv nazorat, ziddiyatni hal qilish va emotsiyani boshqarish.

clinical.en: Involved in depression, OCD and chronic pain.
clinical.uz: Depressiya, OKB va surunkali og'riqda ishtirok etadi.

description.en: Dorsal entorhinal cortex on the uncus.
description.uz: Uncus'dagi dorsal entorinal po'stloq.

role.en: Primary olfactory and memory-related cortex.
role.uz: Birlamchi hidlov va xotira bilan bog'liq po'stloq.

clinical.en: Olfactory auras in temporal lobe epilepsy; uncal herniation.
clinical.uz: Chakka epilepsiyasida hidlov auralari; uncus churrasi.

description.en: Perirhinal cortex along the rhinal sulcus.
description.uz: Rinal egat bo'ylab peririnal po'stloq.

role.en: Object recognition memory and familiarity.
role.uz: Narsani tanish xotirasi va tanishlik hissi.

clinical.en: Early Alzheimer tau pathology.
clinical.uz: Erta Alzheimer tau patologiyasi.

description.en: Ectorhinal / parahippocampal cortex lateral to area 35.
description.uz: 35-maydondan lateral ektorinal / parahippokampal po'stloq.

role.en: Object memory and scene recognition.
role.uz: Narsa xotirasi va manzarani tanish.

clinical.en: Medial temporal atrophy in dementia.
clinical.uz: Demensiyada medial chakka atrofiyasi.

description.en: Fusiform gyrus and the occipitotemporal junction.
description.uz: Fuziform burma va ensa-chakka tutashuvi.

role.en: Face recognition (right), reading (left), object naming and colour.
role.uz: Yuzlarni tanish (o'ng), o'qish (chap), narsalarni nomlash va rang.

clinical.en: Prosopagnosia; alexia; anomia.
clinical.uz: Prozopagnoziya; aleksiya; anomiya.

description.en: The temporal pole.
description.uz: Chakka qutbi.

role.en: Binds names, faces and biographies of people; semantic and social knowledge; emotion via the amygdala.
role.uz: Odamlarning ism, yuz va tarjimai holini bog'laydi; semantik va ijtimoiy bilim; amigdala orqali emotsiya.

clinical.en: Semantic dementia atrophies here first; resected in temporal lobe epilepsy surgery.
clinical.uz: Semantik demensiyada birinchi atrofiya shu yerda; chakka epilepsiyasi jarrohligida rezeksiya qilinadi.

description.en: The angular gyrus in the inferior parietal lobule.
description.uz: Pastki tepa bo'lakchasidagi angular burma.

role.en: Reading, writing, calculation, spatial attention.
role.uz: O'qish, yozish, hisoblash, fazoviy diqqat.

clinical.en: Gerstmann syndrome (left); neglect (right).
clinical.uz: Gerstmann sindromi (chap); e'tiborsizlik (o'ng).

description.en: The supramarginal gyrus in the inferior parietal lobule.
description.uz: Pastki tepa bo'lakchasidagi supramarginal burma.

role.en: Phonological processing, tool use and praxis; empathy (right).
role.uz: Fonologik qayta ishlov, asbob ishlatish va praksis; empatiya (o'ng).

clinical.en: Ideomotor apraxia and conduction aphasia (left).
clinical.uz: Ideomotor apraksiya va o'tkazuvchi afaziya (chap).

description.en: Primary auditory cortex on Heschl's gyrus.
description.uz: Heshl burmasidagi birlamchi eshitish po'stlog'i.

role.en: First cortical analysis of sound, arranged by frequency.
role.uz: Tovushning chastota bo'yicha tartiblangan birinchi po'stloq tahlili.

clinical.en: Cortical deafness only when bilateral.
clinical.uz: Faqat ikki tomonlama bo'lsa kortikal karlik.

description.en: Secondary auditory cortex beside area 41.
description.uz: 41-maydon yonidagi ikkilamchi eshitish po'stlog'i.

role.en: Recognition of complex sounds and speech sounds.
role.uz: Murakkab tovushlar va nutq tovushlarini tanish.

clinical.en: Auditory agnosia.
clinical.uz: Eshitish agnoziyasi.

description.en: Subcentral area at the lower end of the central sulcus, over the insula.
description.uz: Markaziy egatning pastki uchidagi, insula ustidagi subsentral maydon.

role.en: Taste (gustatory cortex) and sensorimotor control of the tongue and pharynx.
role.uz: Ta'm (gustator po'stloq) hamda til va halqumning sensomotor boshqaruvi.

clinical.en: Loss of taste and dysphagia.
clinical.uz: Ta'm yo'qolishi va disfagiya.

description.en: Pars opercularis of the inferior frontal gyrus — the posterior part of Broca's area.
description.uz: Pastki peshona burmasining pars opercularis'i — Broka maydonining orqa qismi.

role.en: Syntax and the motor programming of speech; action understanding (mirror neurons).
role.uz: Sintaksis va nutqning harakat dasturlash; harakatni tushunish (ko'zgu neyronlar).

clinical.en: Broca's aphasia; apraxia of speech.
clinical.uz: Broka afaziyasi; nutq apraksiyasi.

description.en: Pars triangularis of the inferior frontal gyrus — the anterior part of Broca's area.
description.uz: Pastki peshona burmasining pars triangularis'i — Broka maydonining oldingi qismi.

role.en: Semantic retrieval and selection of words.
role.uz: So'zlarni semantik chaqirish va tanlash.

clinical.en: Broca's aphasia with word-finding difficulty.
clinical.uz: So'z topish qiyinchiligi bilan Broka afaziyasi.

description.en: Dorsolateral prefrontal cortex on the middle frontal gyrus.
description.uz: O'rta peshona burmasidagi dorsolateral prefrontal po'stloq.

role.en: Working memory, attention and cognitive flexibility.
role.uz: Ishchi xotira, diqqat va kognitiv moslashuvchanlik.

clinical.en: Executive dysfunction; rTMS target in depression.
clinical.uz: Ijro disfunksiyasi; depressiyada rTMS nishoni.

description.en: Pars orbitalis of the inferior frontal gyrus.
description.uz: Pastki peshona burmasining pars orbitalis'i.

role.en: Semantic processing of language, music syntax and emotional regulation.
role.uz: Tilning semantik qayta ishlovi, musiqa sintaksisi va emotsional boshqaruv.

clinical.en: Contributes to aphasia and disinhibition when damaged.
clinical.uz: Zararlanganda afaziya va tormozsizlikka hissa qo'shadi.
